oracle_snapshots.name: Crosis, the Purger
oracle_snapshots.text:
Flying
Whenever Crosis deals combat damage to a player, you may pay {2}{B}. If you do, choose a color, then that player reveals their hand and discards all cards of that color.

strategy.primary: Discard control: make Crosis connect (evasion, haste, protection), pay {2}{B} to strip a color from the hand, and with Painter's Servant strip the whole hand; punish and harvest discards with Liliana's Caress, Waste Not, Tinybones, Bandit's Talent and Geth's Grimoire.
strategy.secondary: Symmetric hand attack (Mind Twist, Hymn to Tourach, wheels under Notion Thief) and the Notion Thief + Teferi's Puzzle Box lock.

identity.why: Combat-triggered color purge: the deck's defining discard event.
Makes every purge a full-hand discard.
Unblockable for {1} plus ward: the most direct connect enabler.
Turns discarded cards into stolen plays.
Every discard type pays you mana, cards or Zombies.
